verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Trivy is a scanner with documented secret and filesystem scanning, but nothing in the evidence documents a pre-commit hook integration or any way to block secrets before they enter git history. Wiring the CLI into git hooks yourself would be a user-side workaround, and general CI-pipeline praise is a different capability, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the scanner as a pre-commit hook so secrets and issues never enter my git history
